instruction_evidence.quote_en: Stop in front of the bed, with the bed on your left and a TV stand on your right.
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 在床前停下，床在你的左侧，电视柜在你的右侧。

description.zh: 起点附近灰色墙面/立柱占画面主体，右侧可见浅绿色装饰面板；随后视线贴近灰色墙面。
description.en: Near the starting point, a gray wall/pillar dominates the view and a pale green decorative panel is visible on the right; the view then moves close to the gray wall.

description.zh: 出现玻璃淋浴房、浅色瓷砖地面和马桶，表明进入或接近洗浴空间。
description.en: A glass shower enclosure, light-colored tiled floor, and toilet appear, indicating entry into or approach toward a bathing space.

description.zh: B 处右侧可见洗手台与马桶，左侧是大型白色浴缸/平台，背景有挂画与室内开口；木地板窄走廊或任务所要停靠的床前布局未出现。
description.en: At B, a sink and toilet are visible on the right, a large white bathtub/platform is on the left, and framed art and an interior opening are in the background; no wooden-floored narrow hallway or required bed-front stopping layout is shown.

uncertainties.zh: 从灰墙区域到洗浴空间之间的具体转向次数无法由抽样帧精确还原，但不影响已进入洗浴空间且与卧室任务布局冲突的判断。
uncertainties.en: The exact number of turns between the gray-wall area and the bathing space cannot be precisely reconstructed from the sampled frames, but this does not affect the finding that the route has entered a bathing space conflicting with the bedroom task layout.
